description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceReviewAllowedActionsAPI class, which extends an API Endpoint to provide allowed actions for performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve permissible actions based on the review's current state and user permissions, following the REST API standards with appropriate annotations.
